description.value: The Chilliwack Landing Leisure Centre is a YMCA-operated community recreation facility in Chilliwack offering a range of indoor amenities for all ages. Tagged in OSM as a sports centre with ice hockey, it is part of Chilliwack's broader municipal recreation network. Touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack may find it useful as a rest stop, though specific cyclist-relevant amenities could not be confirmed from available content.

judgement.verdict_reason: Duplicate of the Landing Leisure Centre record.

wow_evidence: Desc duplicates the Landing Leisure Centre (eded557484); OSM says ice hockey — probably the adjacent rink but the record adds nothing distinct.
